title: Calendar now loads events for dates you navigate to
summary: External calendar feeds were only ever parsed for a fixed 1-month-back to 6-months-ahead window, so opening a month further back than that showed no events even though the feed had them.
Navigating the calendar (Previous/Next, jumping to a day, Today) now checks whether the visible date is already covered and, if not, widens the loaded window and re-fetches automatically.
